skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: The Land With Me
skins.content: 0011 Custom Brand [Magnificence Curation] Series Collection/The Land With Me. Handmade by a Lungmen craftsman, inspired by Yanese landscape paintings. Thanks to weaving and dyeing techniques rarely seen in the modern age, mounts and seas emerge from the nichang's fabric, blurring fantasy and reality.
skins.quote: I arrive there as I arrive here when wandering mount and sea. The sun, moons and full blossoms gift their scents to you as they do me.

skins.name: Stranded
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Stranded. Recreation of clothes Highmore wore in her hometown. Custom-made flexible support materials keep the skirt puffy, while ribbons of pure white gently sway, giving form to the unknowable sea breeze.
skins.quote: Highmore searches along the seashore. The warm light of the lantern shines upon countless tiny carapaces and bleached bones. They are stranded in the shallows, far, far from home in both distance and time. Highmore stops to listen to the sea breeze, and the nostalgic song it carries.
